name: Sydney Harbour Boat Tours
summary: Private cruises and one small-group tour on Sydney Harbour, run by a family business from Campbells Cove at Circular Quay. Boats are Axopar sports cruisers carrying up to 10 guests, with routes past the city landmarks, national park bays and beaches, and wildlife such as penguins and seals. Whale watching runs offshore from June to October.
standouts: Eco certified by Ecotourism Australia; the site says it was Sydney's first boat tour operator to be recognised with the certification
Private cruises and small groups of up to 10 guests on Axopar sports cruisers
Works on Little Penguin habitat in Sydney Harbour National Park and partners with Take 3 For The Sea

The park waters are home to resident penguin and seal colonies, and guests may see a penguin, seal or dolphin.

The trip runs only when the skipper judges the wind and swell to be acceptable, and guests are told within 48 hours before departure if it cannot go.

checkNotes: Our list described this operator as eco-certified wildlife and penguin tours. The site mainly sells private harbour charters on Axopar sports cruisers (up to 10 guests), one shared lunch cruise (Sydney Secrets) and offshore whale watching. Penguins and seals are mentioned as possible sightings on the Sydney Secrets Lunch Cruise and on the about and eco pages; there is no dedicated penguin tour. Booking is through FareHarbor, not Rezdy, so rezdyAlias is null. Each trip's own Book Now link was recorded as found; no fareharbor.com page was opened. The general Book Now link in the menu is https://fareharbor.com/embeds/book/sydneyharbourboattours/?full-items=yes&flow=1069119. Two trips (New Years Eve and custom Private Charters) are enquiry only and have no link. The Captain's Table link points to a March 2024 calendar and may be old. Prices are 'from' prices. Most private cruises are priced per boat or for 2 people plus a charge per extra guest; the home page labels the six charter cruises 'Per Boat' while the two person trips say 'for 2 people'. Check the basis for each before publishing. Some blog posts and the FAQ conflict with the tour pages (for example a flat AUD $800 per hour charter rate, a maximum of 11 guests, a BBQ on board, and a named yacht club for the Sydney Secrets lunch); the tour pages were used. The home page says shared tours hold up to 10 while the Sydney Secrets page and FAQ say 8. The home page also mentions 'two ticketed cruises' but only Sydney Secrets is shown. Phones: 1300 183 365 (Australia), +61 2 7228 4571 (international), WhatsApp +61 400 709 151. The reservations office is open Monday to Friday 9am to 5:30pm. The address is the departure pontoon (the contact page marker reads 6A Circular Quay West); no office address is given. The about page description says the business has taken tourists on the harbour since 2000; that is not used because it is not in the page text. On the site but not captured as trips: Filming and shoots (boat hire for TV and film productions, by enquiry), Virtual Tours (free 360 degree videos), VIP and celebrity charters, Romance (a page promoting the twilight cruise), and agent and ITO net rates (by enquiry). The Film and TV page shows a 'Sydney Harbour Discovery Cruise' card with no matching trip page. Cancellation and weather terms are on the terms page and were not copied. The Fish Market Cruise Collection is described as available from October 2026.
